Option A (single session, longer):
- 2.5 hours total, covers both console and API end-to-end
- Good if the same group is attending and you want a single recording

Option B (recommended):
- Split into two 90-minute sessions: console (overview + hands-on) and API deep-dive (integration + sandbox)
- Easier for cross-functional teams to join only the parts they need

Suggested windows (all times in EDT):

Can you confirm: preferred date/time, which option you prefer, and a short list of attendees (titles)? Also please let me know the timezone we should send invites in — I’ll send calendar invites in your local time.

If helpful, we can run the console walkthrough first and schedule the API deep-dive for the following week.
